The digest is set up, but it won't start on 19 Oct as you asked, and nothing will post until the scheduler is running.

- **What's scheduled:** a job that posts to #coastal-team every Monday at 08:00 Chicago time (13:00 UTC). It reads #coastal-team and #coastal-random for the previous week and adds open customer items. It leaves out finance figures and anything from DMs.
- **Problem:** the scheduler's next run shows as Mon 2 Nov, not 19 Oct. I couldn't create a one-off run for 19 Oct because the scheduler rejected that date as already past. I don't know why, and I shouldn't have guessed in my first reply that the clock was ahead.
- **Not running yet:** the Hermes gateway isn't running, so the job won't fire at all until it's started.

Someone with access to the scheduler should check the start date and start the gateway before 19 Oct. I posted this in your thread, including the correction.
